text: {"hypotheses":[{"statement":"The QA accuracy drop observed after storing more than 40 items is likely due to cross‑fact interference, which can be alleviated by periodically consolidating the accumulated context into a compact summary—as demonstrated in both the \"compression beats accumulation\" paper and the recent arXiv work on consolidation reducing interference.","confidence":0.78,"support_ids":["60cee832","f126b3ef","13b3b6fa"],"tags":["interference","consolidation","accuracy","memory"]},{"statement":"The rewrite operations planned for the memory‑rewrite system act as an implicit virtual‑context paging mechanism similar to MemGPT’s approach, thereby providing on‑the‑fly consolidation that should yield measurable gains over naive append in the ablation study requested by Reviewer 2.","confidence":0.65,"support_ids":["9186bc5a","f1fbdbac","f126b3ef"],"tags":["rewrite","paging","ablation","memory-rewrite"]}]}
